Name: BLADE_HOMING_ANG_SPEED_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the homing angle and speed parameters for a blade melee attack.

Fields.Name: Tilt Model in Vertical Direction
Fields.Description: If ON, the model tilts in the vertical movement direction.

Fields.Name: Stop on Contact with Target
Fields.Description: If ON, the movement stops on contact with the target.

Fields.Name: Inherit Previous Vertical Angle
Fields.Description: If ON, keeps the vertical angle from before the blade homing started.

Fields.Name: Movement Vertical Correction
Fields.Description: How the vertical movement direction is corrected.

Fields.Name: Turn Angular Velocity
Fields.Description: Horizontal tracking angular velocity. In degrees per second. -1: use the character's own performance.

Fields.Name: Turn Angular Acceleration
Fields.Description: Horizontal tracking angular acceleration. In degrees per second squared. -1: use the character's own performance. 0: treated as infinite (the full angular velocity is always used).

Fields.Name: Vertical Turn Angular Velocity
Fields.Description: Vertical tracking angular velocity. In degrees per second. -1: use the same value as the horizontal Turn Angular Velocity.

Fields.Name: Vertical Turn Acceleration
Fields.Description: Vertical tracking angular acceleration. In degrees per second squared. -1: use the same value as the horizontal Turn Angular Acceleration.

Fields.Name: Tracking Limit: Upper Angle
Fields.Description: Measured from the horizontal: the tracking does not bend upwards beyond this angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Tracking Limit: Lower Angle
Fields.Description: Measured from the horizontal: the tracking does not bend downwards beyond this angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Model Vertical Rotation Angular Velocity
Fields.Description: Angular velocity of the model's vertical rotation. In degrees per second. -1: use the tracking value set above.
